_comment: Machine-readable source of truth for the agent team. Ownership entries ending in '/' are directory prefixes; anything else is an exact file path. A path owned by nobody is orchestrator-owned.

engine.label: agent:engine
engine.summary: Agent loop, LLM facade and providers, skill registry, safety, audit, config, tool routing, jobs and routines, voice, WhatsApp service, CLI/daemon

skills.label: agent:skills
skills.summary: Skills (what the assistant can do) and the platform/ layer that wraps every OS concern: Hyprland/Sway/X11, input, audio, browser, terminal, files

web.label: agent:web
web.summary: Next.js frontend and the web transport (FastAPI server, websocket events, token/Origin/Host auth), and the phone channel (pairing, device frames) the Android app connects to

qa.label: agent:qa
qa.summary: Test infrastructure and the legacy test suite, model evals, layout checks, installer and systemd units, requirements

android.label: agent:android
android.summary: Kravein's Android companion app (Kotlin, Compose): toolchain, pairing, device commands, phone-side tests

frozen._comment: Owner 2026-10-29: the Windows-original tree is being deleted (#124); nothing is frozen any more.

models._comment: Owner rule 2026-10-23: agents ALWAYS run Sonnet at effort medium (start-agent.sh refuses anything else). Hard tasks get a stricter packet; the orchestrator's review catches the rest.
